title: BitShare: Sensitivity-Aware Binning and Bit Sharing for Compacting LLM Weight Storage
abstract: arXiv:2611.28607v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decoding with large language models at small batch sizes is limited by memory bandwidth, so the bits stored per weight largely set its cost. Group-wise integer quantization stores every weight of a group at the same precision, although the input channels of a group differ in sensitivity. We present BITSHARE, a codebook-free weight format that keeps the integer grid and the dequantizer of group-wise quantization but varies precision within each group. Sensitivity-aware binning places the channels of each group into three bins at fixed positions, and static bit sharing with optimal bit-value allocation lets the less sensitive weights share their lower bits, each stored once per group or once per pair of weights. A sharing-aware version of GPTQ chooses every stored value, with no fine-tuning and no codebook. BITSHARE has two modes. translated_title: BitShare：面向大语言模型权重存储压缩的敏感性感知分箱与比特共享方法
translated_abstract: 在小批量规模下使用大语言模型进行解码时受内存带宽限制，因此每个权重存储的比特数在很大程度上决定了其成本。分组整数量化将一个组内的每个权重以相同精度存储，尽管组内各输入通道的敏感度存在差异。我们提出了BITSHARE，一种无需码本的权重格式，它保留了分组量化的整数网格和反量化器，但在每个组内部使用不同的精度。敏感性感知分箱将每个组的通道按照固定位置划分到三个箱中，而采用最优比特-值分配的静态比特共享机制使敏感度较低的权重共享其低位比特，每组只需存储一次或每对权重存储一次。共享感知版本的GPTQ负责选择每个存储的值，无需微调，也无需码本。BITSHARE有两种模式：BITSHARE-U为每个组提供相同的布局，因此其解码器可通过固定线路来路由比特；而BITSHARE-N...（原文在此处截断）
tldr: BITSHARE提出了一种无需码本、无需微调的LLM权重压缩格式，通过敏感性感知分箱和静态比特共享实现组内不同精度的存储，从而显著降低权重存储所需的比特数。
en_tdlr: BITSHARE is a codebook-free, fine-tuning-free weight format that compacts LLM weight storage by achieving intra-group precision variation through sensitivity-aware binning and static bit sharing.
